title: A Dot Broke Claude on Cloudflare's AI Gateway
caption:
I used to think swapping models was a one-line change.

Five opencode releases between Aug 20 and Aug 25 are almost all provider plumbing. Cloudflare's AI Gateway forwarding claude-haiku-4.5 when Anthropic wants claude-haiku-4-5. Retries for network_error and, separately, network-error. textVerbosity going to providers that never accepted it.

"OpenAI-compatible" is a shape, not a contract. The base_url swap is the easy 10%.

Which provider broke yours?

slides.headline:
A dot broke Claude
on Cloudflare
slides.sub: opencode v1.18.23, Aug 25: the AI Gateway forwarded model IDs like claude-haiku-4.5. Anthropic only accepts the dashed slug, claude-haiku-4-5.

slides.headline:
Two spellings,
one error
slides.sub: v1.18.20 added retries for finish_reason: network_error. The same release added network-error. Same failure, different punctuation.

slides.title: What compatible means
items: textVerbosity was reaching OpenAI-compatible providers that do not support it. Stopped in v1.18.22.
An unknown finish_reason ended the response early. v1.18.21 keeps going instead.
Built-in Qwen sampling defaults sent settings the model rejects. Removed in v1.18.19.
Vertex AI eu and us Gemini traffic rerouted through REP endpoints. v1.18.21.
